title: Security literacy and role-based training need deployment records
remediation: The sponsor security and privacy training leads establish initial and recurring literacy that covers insider threat, social engineering and social mining. Set role-specific training before access or duties and at reviewed intervals. Track refresh after system or event changes and revisions to both training streams. Use de-identified learner evidence.

milestones.title: Collect approved curricula and cadence, redacted initial and recurring completion records, and a before-access or before-duty role training sample
